blockers.description: Balıkesir's 1542 KML placemarks have no id attribute at all — no adapter can be built without either a real id field appearing in the source or an explicit user decision on identity strategy.
İstanbul's 1371-feature GeoJSON (verified 2026-09-21) has no id field anywhere (not in properties, not as GeoJSON feature.id) — same blocker as Balıkesir, newly confirmed rather than assumed.

99.6% of Overture's Turkey strong-new-candidate pool comes from a single provider (Meta/Facebook Places, crowdsourced) with observed taxonomy mistagging even within the structurally-correct 'park' leaf (a zoo, a picnic area, a motocross track, etc. all tagged taxonomy.primary=='park'). Confidence score does not separate good from bad records. Needs an explicit secondary-filter or REVIEW-only-treatment decision before any future onboarding.

ULASAV's catalog surfaces many municipalities but per-dataset quality varies enormously (verified via 3-city POC: Van excellent with real OBJECTID+names, Osmaniye has geometry but zero usable attributes ('Unknown Area Type' on every row), Bursa's 'Parklar' dataset is actually a small curated tourism list, not a park inventory). No amount of shared discovery infrastructure removes the need for per-dataset verification before building any adapter.

Two real limitations found in scripts/inspect-ulasav-candidates.mjs, not yet fixed: (1) taxonomy keyword regex doesn't match Turkish plural forms like 'Parklar' (no word boundary before 'lar'); (2) field-guesser can pick an uninformative free-text field (e.g. facility amenity notes) over falling back to dataset-title inference. Neither changed a final classification this batch, but both should be fixed before the classifier is trusted on a wider run.

fixes_applied.field_selection: Exact-name priority lists (NAME_FIELD_PRIORITY, TAXONOMY_FIELD_PRIORITY) replace loose regex matching. True ties -> BLOCKED_SCHEMA (fired for real on Konya's own already-integrated dataset: POI_ID vs feature.id tied). New name_field_inferred path: when no taxonomy field exists but >=50% of a real NAME field's values contain the word 'park' per-row, that's genuine row-level evidence -- this is what makes Van's regression pass.
fixes_applied.license_carry_forward: scripts/ulasav-license-evidence.mjs builds an org->license lookup from data/municipal-park-sources.json + data/sources-registry.json's already-verified facts + the ulasav-license pattern. Every dataset now records license_status/license_source/license_url/license_verified_at, tracing to a concrete prior verification.

bugs_found_and_fixed_during_full_run: 1st attempt: 39/71 DOWNLOAD_FAILED, Van regressed to READY_AFTER_SMALL_PARSER. Root cause 1 (29 failures): zip extraction always searched for *.shp even when loading .kmz (Manisa's ~40 datasets). Tried GDAL /vsizip/ virtual filesystem -- failed to open ordinary zips in this GDAL build (verified directly). Reverted to manual unzip searching for the extension matching the declared format. Root cause 2 (Van): stricter field-selection correctly stopped picking an uninformative free-text field but had no fallback for a real name-field-based park signal -- added name_field_inferred path.
Verified both fixes in isolation (single-dataset Van test) before re-running the full 71-dataset batch a third time, to avoid burning another ~10min batch on an unverified guess.
